entities.summary: The foundational salvation event of the Hebrew Bible (c. 1313 or 1250 BCE): God delivered the Israelites from Egyptian slavery through the ten plagues, the Passover, and the crossing of the Red Sea. Commemorated annually in the Passover (Pesach) festival.
